reading_note: The teaching describes four discrete operations by which the awakening Divine Truth (the Ambassador/Third Messenger) calls trapped good and truth back from the natural mind. The arc moves: (1) the form of divine truth becomes visible in glory; (2) the boundary between the spiritual and natural is opened then closed at the appointed state; (3) the good and the perception within man are selected out from the mixture; (4) the awakening enters the regenerate man, becoming light to the soul which lives, completing a perfection that overcomes the states of enmity (self-love and its falsities).
